representations.name: arithmetic bad-event cluster hypergraph
representations.new_information: retains intersections through both shared integers and shared active-prime valuation rows
representations.first_test: measure complete event clusters on rough path circuits and circuit books rather than assuming bounded event size or degree

representations.name: polymer boundary alteration
representations.new_information: treats a connected active-incidence component as one repair polymer with an exposed boundary
representations.first_test: test whether forests are automatically safe or whether a minimal path polymer has arbitrary diameter

representations.name: fractional witness compression by prime rows
representations.new_information: charges a repair to the log-defect mass of valuation rows shared by its whole failure cluster
representations.first_test: seek an all-N inequality making total cluster charge o(log N) times sum w_N and test it on ordered paths

representations.name: ordered largest-prime rational residue
representations.new_information: stores the exact signed cofactor ratio transferred when the top-prime incidence counts balance
representations.first_test: apply the universal double-star extension and quantify residue fan size, height, and subsequent prime depth

representations.name: owner-load flow network
representations.new_information: routes each minimal circuit through a top-prime/cofactor state to an owner vertex and records shared owner congestion
representations.first_test: formulate a noncircular owner map and test its load on long ordered paths and overlapping double stars

representations.name: cofactor gcd and divisor-lattice split
representations.new_information: retains coprimality and divisor containment of top endpoint cofactors instead of only their sizes
representations.first_test: check whether coprime top cofactors actually split the global lower relation in the double-star gadget

representations.name: signed residue-token factor forest
representations.new_information: replaces a peeled incidence by two signed cofactor tokens while retaining their links to all lower primes
representations.first_test: write the exact token transition along an increasingly labelled active-prime path and test token-count decrease

representations.name: component diameter treewidth and cycle-rank state
representations.new_information: separates local degree from global forest diameter and cyclic complexity
representations.first_test: use RR.1 to decide which of degree, cycle rank, treewidth, diameter, or support can be a strictly decreasing potential

representations.name: multiscale residue coarea potential
representations.new_information: integrates decreases in cofactor height, active-prime scale, component support, and log-defect rather than counting peel steps
representations.first_test: derive a telescoping inequality on an ordered path or exhibit a path whose charge repeats at every edge

representations.name: growing prime-prefix reserve process
representations.new_information: allows future large primes to force revisions paid from an explicit sparse reserve
representations.first_test: apply the double-star future extension to quantify the reserve required before a lower decision can stabilize

representations.name: profinite revision martingale
representations.new_information: tracks conditional deletion density and pointwise decision changes as controlled prime cylinders grow
representations.first_test: prove summability of revision probabilities and zero upper density, or construct non-summable double-star completions

representations.name: rough circuit primal packing
representations.new_information: packs or overlaps path and double-star circuits to test whether a proposed owner or alteration cost is truly global
representations.first_test: compare disjoint paths, shared-boundary path books, and common-top-prime double stars against each candidate charge
